title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AidPackage
architecture_notes: Equivalent PeopleSoft records: PS_STDNT_AID, PS_STDNT_BUDGET_IT, PS_STDNT_AWARDS, PS_ITEM_TYPE_FA, PS_ISIR_COMPUTED, PS_STDNT_AID_ATRBT. Attribute names match bridge/peoplesoft/cs/aid_package_mapping.json one for one, so PeopleSoft and Workday land in the same HELIX shape and can be reconciled directly.

source_objects.description: Student cost of attendance for the award year and period, with COA items.
The student's package for the award year: awards, need, and status.
Event recording PJ adjustments to COA or SAI.

notes: RESTRICTED. This is a FERPA education record and GLBA-covered customer financial information. Land in bronze under the restricted KMS key, tokenize SAI, COD loan IDs, and PJ or appeal text at silver, and grant only to financial aid roles (govern/access-control-matrix.json, ACM-SPECIAL-002).
validate: Workday object and field names follow Workday Student Financial Aid naming but vary by release and tenant configuration. VALIDATE each against your tenant's report data sources before building RaaS or Web Services extracts.
